content:
alex: Quick pass — storyboard for the product announcement blog is up: https://paper.redwood.com/p/blog-announce/storyboard. Can folks do a last readability + benchmark-claim sanity check?

marta: On it. I skimmed the benchmark section — needs one sentence that explains the test workload (chat + long context) not just the p99 numbers.

sam: I can reword the benchmark blurb. Suggest: "Across a mixed chat and streaming workload (avg conv length ~600 tokens), Redwood reduced per-token compute by ~28% vs baseline using dynamic batching and prefix cache." Thoughts?

alex: +1 on specificity. But kasia/legal should OK the exact percent.

kasia: I need the underlying CSV or eval run ID to clear specific percentages. Share run id or remove the exact number and use a range.

sam: Run ID: run_2026_03_18_v7. Attaching snippet: ```workload: chat+stream
avg_ctx: 600
metric: per_token_compute_relative: 0.72```

marta: Nice. If legal wants a range we can say "~25–30%" instead of 28%.

oliver: On the CTA/webinar routing side — we need a mapping for the hero CTA -> HubSpot form -> webinar seat allocation. Current ask from demand gen: 2x demo seats per enterprise lead for first 48h, then 1x afterwards.

jenni: Webinar hosted Tue 2026-04-05 09:00 PT, capacity 250. We reserved 40 demo seats (round-robin ops). We should call them out in the FAQ: how demo seats are assigned.

alex: Can we include the hubspot form id + property mapping? Put the snippet in the blog so ops can wire it.

sam: Draft mapping (please confirm):
```hubspot_form_id: hs_981231
properties:
  email: contact.email
  company: contact.company
  interest_level: multi_choice
  route_to: campaign_tag = "product-announce-apr"
```

kasia: Cool, legal needs the CTA copy for claims and a short MD of how leads are processed (data residency note).

alex: Draft CTA copy in doc: "Register for the product launch webinar — limited demo seats available." Keep it short. Add data residency note: "Leads from EU will be routed to our EU region HubSpot instance."

legal-bot: automated-check: no GDPR-sensitive PII collected beyond email/company. Please ensure EU routing policy confirmed by infra.

marta: Editorial notes: tighten the opener paragraph, remove passive voice, and make the demo flow bullet list. Also remove the phrase "breakthrough latency" — too marketingy.

jenni: For approvals timeline: ops/marketing sign-off by Thu EOD, legal sign-off by Fri EOB, publish slot Mon morning. Can everyone ack?

oliver: Ack — I'll confirm HubSpot webhook and seat assignment script by Thu 3pm PT.

sam: Ack — will update benchmark wording and paste the CSV link.

kasia: Ack — will confirm legal language and EU routing by Fri noon.

alex: Thanks. If no blocker, I'll queue the draft for publish review after legal clears. :thumbsup:

marta: One last micro ask — can we surface the quick demo signup flow under the hero as a 3-step: Register -> Confirm seat (email) -> Book demo slot (calendar). Keeps expectations clear.

alex: Perfect. I'll update the doc and ping when queued for final review.

jenni: FYI — planning a 30-min dry run with product on Mon prior to publish. Invite list in the doc.

sam: tagging @marta @kasia for final sweep once I paste updated wording.

legal-bot: reminder: include retention period for lead data in the privacy appendix (suggested: 24 months).
